query_name: Question 1 Eligible partners by service area and time frame: SELECT organizations, organization_services, services, service_areas, service_priority_support, priority_levels
source_file: database/queries.sql:15 (Question 1 Eligible partners by service area and time frame)
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT
    o.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    s.name AS service_name,
    sa.region_name AS service_area,
    pl.level_name AS supported_priority,
    pl.deadline_hours,
    os.status AS service_offering_status,
    os.active_referral_limit,
    os.current_active_referrals,
    (os.active_referral_limit - os.current_active_referrals) AS available_slots
FROM organizations o
JOIN organization_services os
    ON o.organization_id = os.organization_id
JOIN services s
    ON os.service_id = s.service_id
JOIN service_areas sa
    ON os.service_area_id = sa.area_id
JOIN service_priority_support sps
    ON os.organization_service_id = sps.organization_service_id
JOIN priority_levels pl
    ON sps.priority_id = pl.priority_id
WHERE o.status = 'approved'
  AND os.status = 'active'
  AND sps.is_supported = TRUE
  AND s.service_id = 1
  AND sa.area_id = 1
  AND pl.level_name = 'High'
ORDER BY available_slots DESC

    sr.request_id,
    sr.title AS request_title,
    pl.level_name AS priority,
    sr.attendance_deadline,

    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sr.attendance_deadline, ar.first_attended_at) AS delay_minutes,
    ref.referral_id,
    ref.attempt_number,
    (ref.attempt_number > 1) AS is_backup,
    o.name AS responsible_organization,
    ar.notes AS attendance_notes
FROM attendance_records ar
JOIN service_requests sr
    ON ar.request_id = sr.request_id
JOIN priority_levels pl
    ON sr.priority_id = pl.priority_id
JOIN referrals ref
    ON ar.referral_id = ref.referral_id
JOIN organizations o
    ON ref.organization_id = o.organization_id
WHERE ar.is_on_time = FALSE
   OR ar.first_attended_at > sr.attendance_deadline
ORDER BY delay_minutes DESC

INSERT INTO referral_status_history
(
    referral_id,
    old_status,
    new_status,
    changed_by_user_id,
    notes,
    changed_at
)
SELECT
    r.referral_id,
    h.old_status,
    h.new_status,
    CASE
        WHEN h.new_status IN ('accepted', 'rejected',
                              'attended', 'completed')
        THEN rep.user_id
        ELSE NULL
    END,
    CONCAT('Demo: referral ', h.new_status),
    CASE h.new_status
        WHEN 'sent' THEN r.created_at
        WHEN 'accepted' THEN r.responded_at
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN r.responded_at
        WHEN 'timed_out' THEN r.response_deadline
        WHEN 'attended' THEN
            DATE_ADD(r.responded_at, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
        WHEN 'completed' THEN r.updated_at
    END
FROM referrals r
JOIN service_requests sr
    ON sr.request_id = r.request_id
LEFT JOIN organization_representatives rep
    ON rep.organization_id = r.organization_id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT NULL AS old_status, 'sent' AS new_status
    UNION ALL SELECT 'sent', 'accepted'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'sent', 'rejected'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'sent', 'timed_out'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'accepted', 'attended'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'attended', 'completed'
) h
WHERE sr.title LIKE '[DEMO] %'
AND (
    h.new_status = 'sent'
    OR (h.new_status = 'accepted'
        AND r.status IN ('accepted','attended','completed'))
    OR (h.new_status = 'attended'
        AND r.status IN ('attended','completed'))
    OR (h.new_status = 'completed'
        AND r.status = 'completed')

        LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_id=r.organization_id
